title: Capability and Interpretability of Transformers on Multi-task Recurrence
abstract: arXiv:2611.31260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformers are widely used in various language tasks, with limited understanding of their internal mechanisms. Motivated by the recurrent structure of many linguistic rules, we study the capability and interpretability of Transformers through a controlled family of linear recurrence tasks over finite cyclic groups. These tasks range from executing a single fixed rule to identifying a latent rule from context and switching between explicitly specified rules, with and without input masking. Through extensive experiments across different configurations, we find that switching specified rules is simpler than identifying latent rules for Transformers in general. We also identify how several key factors affect the generalization capability of Transformers, including the depth, width, and the algebraic structure of the linear recurrence. translated_title: Transformer在多任务递归上的能力与可解释性
translated_abstract: Transformer被广泛应用于各类语言任务中，但人们对其内部机制的理解仍然有限。受许多语言规则的递归结构启发，我们通过有限循环群上的线性递归任务这一受控任务族，研究了Transformer的能力与可解释性。这些任务涵盖了从执行单个固定规则、从上下文中识别潜在规则，到在明确指定的规则之间进行切换，且包含有输入掩码和无输入掩码两种情形。通过对不同配置的大量实验，我们发现总体而言，对Transformer来说，切换明确指定的规则比识别潜在规则更为简单。我们还识别出影响Transformer泛化能力的若干关键因素，包括深度、宽度以及线性递归的代数结构。当规则数量较多时，课程学习的收益极为显著。借助机制可解释性领域的标准工具……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过有限循环群上的线性递归任务族系统研究了Transformer的能力与可解释性，发现切换明确指定的规则比识别潜在规则更容易，并揭示了模型深度、宽度以及递归的代数结构对泛化能力的影响，同时证明课程学习在规则数量较大时尤为有效。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates the capability and interpretability of Transformers on a controlled family of linear recurrence tasks over finite cyclic groups, showing that switching explicitly specified rules is easier than identifying latent rules, and revealing how model depth, width, and the algebraic structure of the recurrence affect generalization, with curriculum learning proving highly beneficial when the number of rules is large.
